author: TDN75

title: Expensive for what it actually is.
body:
This app is OK but nothing special. For the price I would hope for more. Some improvements I would suggest are … being able to mark habits as done on Apple Watch. 
Instead of just having information in written form only. 
Having videos or audio “lessons” would make using this app, more enjoyable and easier. 
Also, the aesthetics of the app are a bit basic.
 It was nice to be able to try the app but I don’t think I’ll be buying it.

author: User_der_App-Pippo

title: Quite expensive
body:
18$ a month just to have 2 more habits? Or 10$ if you instantly drop 120$/year …. I‘ll test the free period but I don‘t think it will convince me to spend that much money.

Also, there‘s currently no way to delete a logged habit. I created a widget and then tried to see how it works and now have 3 logged habits even though I actually didn‘t do them - but I have found no way to just simply remove them or reset the state without having to create the whole habit itself or deleting the data/account

author: chris463

title: Turning the newsletter into something my lazy self can actually do.
body:
Had the chance to test the beta app before launch and see the rapid improvements. 
I’ve tested many of these so called “get better” apps and none of them worked for me. But this one does because of its simplicity and focus on making small incremental changes, nothing else. Create one habit, choose frequency and remember why you’re doing it. Check in and get it done, then move to the next one. Thanks for making this tangible from your already great snippets of wisdom in the newsletter (and now Mindset tab)!
